evidence.run-one: Final run-03 used fresh writable state and booted Android 7.1.1/API-25/ARM64 with ADB and a reviewed launcher screenshot. Ordinary stock APK installation returned INSTALL_FAILED_SHARED_USER_INCOMPATIBLE. Launch was not reached. out/guest-baseline/run-03/result.toml and evidence-sha256.txt retain raw evidence; all indexed hashes verified after cleanup. Reviewed relative locators and hashes are in experiments/guest-baseline/results.toml.
evidence.run-two: Final run-04 repeated from separate fresh state with the same pinned inputs. Guest boot, graphics, platform certificate and signing rejection agree with run-03. All evidence-sha256.txt entries verified after cleanup. Raw evidence is under out/guest-baseline/run-04/; screenshots from both final runs were visually inspected.
evidence.outcome-classification: experiments/guest-baseline/results.toml SHA-256 ac72c50eeba3ed909b2c57786871ab0002c32329155225b0bb2040cc77ba4ab0 and docs/research/guest-baseline.md distinguish completed guest boot, failed package admission, and application launch not reached. Platform certificate c8a2e9bccf597c2fb6dc66bee293fc13f2fc47ec77bc6b2b0d52c11f51192ab8 differs from the stock APK certificate. Preliminary runs agreed operationally but revealed checksum-index self-inclusion; the corrected runner was rerun twice. No guest signing exception or hardware substitution was introduced.
evidence.input-preservation: Post-run shasum checks passed for all nine extracted guest files, four runtime executables, the stock APK copy, and the reference ELF. Each final run also checked its inputs before starting. Verification logs remain in out/guest-baseline/inputs/post-run-*-verification.txt. No listeners remain on the three experiment ports.
